cited.quote: Establishment of Multi- Disciplinary Critical Care Units (Hybrid High Dependency Unit) at 32 Government Hospitals

rationale: C4 is a GO (2019-05-31) sanctioning critical care units (high dependency units with ICU equipment) at 32 government hospitals, covering only part of the promise of ICUs in all government hospitals. C1, C2, C3 and C5 concern other projects, trauma care levels, insurance definitions and cath labs.

cited.quote: The total members registered under the scheme as on 29.02.2020 are as below:-

rationale: C1 shows the Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (started 2011) still being implemented, with registration continuing and members counted as on 29.02.2020, so the scheme was continued. No extract gives an earlier dated step after taking office; date is the dated registration figure in C1. C2-C5 concern other schemes.

cited.quote: is under implementation in Government General Hospital, Chennai from 1.3.2016 and in Tamil Nadu Government Multi Super Speciality Hospital
This programme is being extended to the Government Medical College Hospitals at Coimbatore, Madurai and Tirunelveli.

rationale: C1-C3 show the check-up scheme running only at two Chennai hospitals (one added 2018, same district); extension to Coimbatore, Madurai and Tirunelveli is only stated as intent (C2), and C3 (2020-21) still lists only the Chennai hospitals. No expansion to other districts is shown.

cited.quote: issued orders in G.O. (Ms.) No.465, Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Dated 27.11.2018 to implement a Special Regularization Scheme

rationale: C3 shows free house-site pattas continuing to be issued each year 2016-17 to 2018-19 and a GO of 27.11.2018 granting 3 cents of free house site to poor families. No earlier dated GO after taking office is shown, so the date is from that GO. C1, C4, C5 concern house construction.

cited.quote: The administrative sanction for the project was accorded by the Government vide G.O.(Ms.)No.23, Revenue Department, dated 21.1.2014

rationale: C1 shows the order implementing the coastal disaster risk reduction project was issued on 21.1.2014, before this government took office, so it does not count. No extract shows a new order by this government; C4 and C5 are renaming orders.

cited.quote: sanctioned a sum of Rs.54,00,000/- from State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) for the preparation of Comprehensive Flood Protection Plan

rationale: C5 (2017-18 policy note, listed as a new initiative) reports a sanction of Rs.54 lakh from SDRF for a flood protection plan in 8 vulnerable coastal districts. No exact sanction date is given; year from C5. C1 SDRF allocations are statewide; C4 project funding dates from 2014.

cited.quote: Evacuation Routes with signage boards were constructed covering 143 villages at a cost of Rs.25 crore
121 Multipurpose Evacuation Shelters have been constructed in the coastal districts at a cost of Rs.331.03 crore and put to use

rationale: C1 and C3 report infrastructure works under the coastal project built and put to use (houses, evacuation routes, 121 shelters, fishing harbour works, underground cable pilot). The project itself was sanctioned in 2014; no extract dates a launch by this government, so the date is only the earliest report (C1). Low certainty on the date.

cited.quote: in all high and higher secondary schools in the academic year 2016-17 was introduced. Under this scheme, 770 Government High and Higher Secondary Schools

rationale: C1 states the Integrated Learning Scheme through Internet was introduced in high and higher secondary schools in academic year 2016-17, with virtual classrooms provided to 770 government schools and 11 DIETs. Matches the promise. C2-C5 do not concern it.
